text_block_list.text:
One day, while training towards our next 
goal, the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Bench press finished~. Trainer, can I take 
a little break?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alright, just for 10 minutes.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heh... heh...! Three more sets...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that...

Following Nice Nature's gaze, I saw Tokai 
Teio pouring her heart and soul into 
training.

It looks like they're using a special 
machine that assists the body, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Nature-chan~♪ Let's take a break 
together!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Mayano, perfect timing. Say, what's 
Teio doing over there?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing my rehab! After all, it was a 
pretty bad injury.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Teio-chan was in bed for quite a 
long time, y'know~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Oww, my legs are totally swollen~! 
Maybe I pushed myself a little too hard?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It seems Teio is quite fired up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's the President! Of course, I'm in 
tip-top shape and giving it my best!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I'd love to say that, but I'm still far 
from top shape.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can see the path to a full 
recovery! I might even come back stronger 
than before♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I thought the first thing out of her mouth 
would be a demand for praise for her hard 
work, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, I don't want that! If I'm gonna be 
praised, I want it to be when I win!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, of course I have to work hard! I 
can't afford to stumble in a place like 
this."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If I don't get better soon, I can't run. 
And if I can't run... I'll never catch up 
to the Prez. Right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see. No, pardon me. It seems I 
underestimated your mental fortitude.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is a period where abilities stabilize 
and one is fulfilled in mind and body. 
Even for me, getting injured at such a 
time is agonizing.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...So you came to cheer me up. Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Seriously, Pres, who do you think I am?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible in both races and Lives! 
Faster, stronger, and cooler than anyone 
else."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm... *I* am the invincible Lord Teio! No 
matter what happens, I'll hop right over 
it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That's right. I expect great things 
from you, Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Doesn't it look even brighter than 
before?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Hitting a wall only made me stronger... 
or something like that, I guess."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even though a nobody like me... hits a 
wall and just completely loses her mind.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Bouncing back that easily... The 
protagonist really is in a league of their 
own.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, was it really that easy? Teio-chan 
was crying a whole lot, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
She couldn't run in an important race, 
after all. It looked so, so painful for 
her.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Even Teio...

During the training that followed, Nice 
Nature seemed to be lost in thought about 
something.

—And after training was over, she quietly 
opened up about her feelings bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I'd always assumed so. No, maybe... I 
just wanted to believe that."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Teio is strong because she's the main 
character. Because she was born with 
innate talent. Because she was destined to 
stand in the spotlight right from the 
start.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I protected my fragile self by thinking, 
"Of course she's different from a nobody 
like me."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But... that's not it. Teio's just like me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even if you work hard, you might still 
lose or get injured. ...I know how painful 
that can be, too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What's different is... what happens after 
something painful. Her strength lies in 
her ability to get back up on her own.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously, looking back on it now gives 
me the chills. To think I actually 
intended to beat someone that strong.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Someone like me has no guts or courage, 
yet all I ever do is look up at others and 
whine that it's not fair.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—You're the one who stepped down saying 
you couldn't stand on that stage.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Presumptuous, greedy, and spoiled. Even 
so... even so...!
choice_data_list: Even so, I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If I have even a little bit in common with 
her... Then maybe, even I...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Even I can...!

She didn't continue past that, but the 
determination in her eyes said it all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Right!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...This year's Arima Kinen. A race Teio 
was surely supposed to run in too."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win. I'll make everyone, 
especially Teio... realize that I'm right 
here too!
